title: rouliniella
intro: Rouliniella, commonly known as Rouliniella compacta, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Rouliniella include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rouliniella, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which also include anti-cancer and anti-viral properties.
